true_transition_recommendation.reason: GR014 directly removes field finiteness from the coordinate-image closedness claim while retaining finite row support, full assignment space, discrete topology and ZFC; the proof changes from compactness to finite-coordinate linear equations. GR016 is a valid true control but replaces pointwise existence with actual compatible sections on a finite principal-open cover, so it is a data/quantifier mechanism change rather than pure weakening.
